brief: This lesson-1 orientation exercise applies the information-handoff process: identify unresolved site conditions, hold the movement request, and seek qualified review. All route data are fictional. It is an administrative decision exercise, not a driving game. No answer releases a route or establishes operating competence. Reassess updated information while preserving restrictions until the employer resolves the hazards.
